skillset.skill: 10s CT - 3000% Light DMG (PHY). Summon a kin with 1000 HP (MAX: 4). Summoned kins will redirect all DMG taken by Goddess Celia to themselves.
skillset.arts: 20000% Light DMG (PHY). Increase all Human allies' Arts gauge by 30. For 20s, reduce enemies' Light RES by 30%.
skillset.truearts: 60000% Light DMG (PHY). Summon 4 kins with 1000 HP (MAX: 4). Summoned kins will redirect all DMG taken by Goddess Celia to themselves.
skillset.superarts: 160000% DMG (PHY). Sacrifice all kins. Increase own CRI rate by 100% for the duration of Super Arts and own Super CRI rate by [20 × # of kins sacrificed from current Super Arts]% (MAX: 80%) for the duration of Super Arts.

passive.ability1: For each kin killed or sacrificed throughout battle, increase own DMG by 30% (MAX: 600%). Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: When HP is above 90%, increase own Arts by 5/s.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Goddess Celia's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Goddess Celia's SP. Art is owned)

passiveJP.ability1: For each kin killed or sacrificed throughout battle, increase own DMG by 30% (MAX: 600%). Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passiveJP.ability2: When HP is above 90%, increase own Arts by 5/s.

trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 12000% Light DMG (PHY). If user is Light, for 10s, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 20%. If user is Light and above 80% HP, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 35% instead.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Goddess Celia, increase own DMG and Skill CT Speed by 30%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
